sphere_commentary.overview:
The dataset demonstrates consistent efficacy across series with moderate variation reflecting design intent.
• HEALING shows lowest variance (std 1.77) and high mean (6.98).
• THRIVING achieves comparable means (6.96) with slightly higher focus outcomes.
• TRANSFORMING exhibits widest spread (std 1.87) aligning with ascending‑arc design.
sphere_commentary.cross_series:
Series efficacy aligns with design goals.
• HEALING DESCENT protocols cluster near mean 6.9–7.2 with 60‑72% positive.
• THRIVING HOLD protocols vary but many achieve >7.0 mean scores.
• TRANSFORMING ASCENT protocols show bimodal outcomes, 43‑71% positive.
sphere_commentary.anomalies:
Several protocols display unexpected distributions.
• H-CR-L3 (bimodal, high top‑tier responses) suggests subgroup effect.
• X-ME-L3 (mean 5.7, high std 2.45) indicates possible mismatch.
• T-FC-L3 (high mean 7.63, high std 1.97) signals divergent listener reactions.
sphere_commentary.development_signals:
Targeted refinement can address outliers.
• [CONVERGENT SIGNAL] H-OS-L1 – increase hold phase duration to offset early drop‑off.
• [CONVERGENT SIGNAL] T-FC-L3 – experiment with steeper frequency sweep.
• [CONVERGENT SIGNAL] X-ME-L2 – degrade early rhythm bias.
• [CONVERGENT SIGNAL] H-CR-L2 – augment grounding cues.
sphere_commentary.embedding_analysis:
Embedding analysis reveals evolving analytical patterns.
• CROSS-RUN DRIFT: notable drift in X-MD-L3, H-SL-L1, T-FC-L3, X-ME-L2.
• CROSS-PROTOCOL SEMANTIC CLUSTERS: H-SL-L1/L2 form tight group; T-CF-L3 most isolated.
• Confidence: embedding signals robust with ~15 protocols showing strong pattern consistency.
